macro.title: One blood test could screen you for 50 cancers. Here’s why it’s controversial. - washingtonpost.com
macro.summary: A Food and Drug Administration committee backed a cancer blood test called Galleri but was split on how well it works. The test is awaiting a final decision by the FDA.

macro.title: Aldi is cutting prices on a third of its products. Here's when - USA Today
macro.summary: The grocery chain said the price cuts are expected to save customers $86 million.

macro.title: Oracle Cites ‘Force Majeure’ to Shield Itself on Controversial Data Center - Bloomberg.com
macro.summary: Oracle Corp. is moving to shield itself from racking up expenses on a massive data center being built in New Mexico, adding a fresh wrinkle to a project beset by opposition and regulatory setbacks.

macro.title: Iced coffee, tattoos, thank-you notes: The shifting do’s and don’ts of job interviews - The Washington Post
macro.summary: An explosive debate over iced coffee highlights how tricky it can be to navigate interview etiquette.

macro.title: Thyroid medicine recall receives FDA's highest risk level - USA Today
macro.summary: A recalled thyroid medicine has been classified under the FDA's most serious risk level, indicating it could potentially be deadly.
